621: ਅਟਲ ਬਚਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇਰਾ; ਸਫਲ ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੪੯॥
Nanak: O Guru, Your word never fails; You place Your blessed hand on our foreheads. ॥2॥21॥49॥
ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ; ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
All beings are created by the Lord, and the Lord is the saints' helper.
ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੈ; ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੧॥
The Lord keeps the honour of the Lord's own servant, and that honour stays whole. ॥1॥
The perfect Supreme Lord is always with me.
ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ. ਪੂਰੀ ਸਭ ਰਾਖੀ; ਹੋਏ ਸਰਬ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Perfect Guru has kept my honour fully; the Guru is merciful to all. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ; ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
Night and day Nanak meditates on the Name of the Giver of life and breath.
ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੈ; ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਪਿਤ ਮਾਤਾ ॥੨॥੨੨॥੫੦॥
God holds the Lord's own servant close to the heart, as parents care for a child. ॥2॥22॥50॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Meeting the village elders, the dread of the vices was not removed;
the chiefs gave no assurance either;
the dispute was taken before the officials too, to no avail;
meeting the Lord, the Sovereign, it was settled. ॥1॥
Now I need not go searching anywhere else,
since I have met the Lord of the universe, the Guru, the Master of the world. ॥ Rahao
When one comes into God's presence,
Then one attains what is truly one's own,
and no longer wanders coming and going. ॥2॥
There, in God's presence, the case is settled by true justice;
there master and servant are held alike.
and understands the pain without a word being spoken. ॥3॥
God is the Sovereign of all places;
in union with God the unstruck Word of praise resounds within.
Nanak: meet God by giving up self-conceit. ॥4॥1॥51॥
Enshrine the Name in your heart.
Stay within yourself and meditate on the Guru.
Whoever the Perfect Guru taught the true Name
Those on whom the beloved Guru becomes kind,
ਅਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਮੰਗਲ ਸਿਉ; ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
bathe in the Name and settle within, full of bliss, peace, well-being and joy. ॥ Rahao
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ; ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
The Guru is King above the kings of the world;
meeting the Guru, a longing for the Name wells up in the mind. ॥2॥
Meditating on the Lord's Name, the treasure of virtues,
all of life's aims are fulfilled. ॥3॥
The Guru has opened the door of liberation from vice;
the whole creation hails the Guru.
and all fear of birth and death is gone. ॥4॥2॥52॥
Since the Perfect Guru showed grace,
Bathing in the Name, I rest within myself,
and enjoy bliss, joy and peace. ॥1॥
O saints, through the Lord's Name we are carried across.
ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Standing and sitting, meditate on the Lord; do this good deed night and day. ॥1॥ Rahao
622: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ. ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ; ਕੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
This is the Guru's path, the ladder of dharma; only a rare, fortunate one finds it.
ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਨਾਸੇ; ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
Whoever fixes the mind on the Lord's feet has the sins of millions of births destroyed. ॥2॥
ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ. ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ; ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਕਲ ਰਾਖੀ ॥
Ever praise your God, who holds the whole creation in power.
ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੀ ॥੩॥
All who take in the True Guru's teaching of the eternal Name become pure. ॥3॥
ਬਿਘਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ. ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਨ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ. ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
Those in whom the True Guru has fixed the Name, remover of obstacles and destroyer of all pain,
ਖੋਏ ਪਾਪ. ਭਏ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਵਨ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੁਖਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੩॥
have their sins destroyed and become pure; servant Nanak: they rest within in peace. ॥4॥3॥53॥
You are the Master, the Lord of virtues, deep and vast of heart.
Home and all belongings are Your gift.
O Great One, Sustainer of the world, Protector,
You are merciful to all beings. ॥1॥
Enshrining the Guru's feet, I remain in bliss.
ਭਉ ਕਤਹਿ ਨਹੀ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In God's shelter no fear can touch anywhere. ॥ Rahao
O Lord, Your Name dwells in the hearts of Your servants.
O God, You have laid an unshakeable foundation of devotion in them.
You are my strength, my wealth, my support;
Whoever has found the Guru's company
The one to whom God in grace gave the taste of the Name
ever abides in joy and well-being. ॥3॥
the whole world rises to fall at their feet.
Meditate on God with every breath;
Nanak, sing the song of the Lord's praise. ॥4॥4॥54॥
Within me abide peace, poise and bliss;
I have met God, who is pleasing to my mind.
Since the Perfect Guru showed grace,
my spiritual state has been raised. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
The one whose mind is absorbed in loving devotion to the Lord
has the unstruck harp of bliss ever playing within. ॥ Rahao
Whoever takes the mighty support of the Lord's feet
is freed from all dependence on people.
They find the Giver, the life of the world,
and sing the Lord's praises with deep love. ॥2॥
God has cut the noose of Death,
and the hope of my mind is fulfilled.
Wherever I look, there is the Lord;
ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
besides the Lord God I see no other. ॥3॥
Those whom God in grace protected
were rid of the pains of countless births.
Those who meditated on the Name of the Fearless One
have found, Nanak, the bliss that never fades. ॥4॥5॥55॥
The one within whom the Creator spread coolness,
the fever of vice has left their household.
The one whom the Perfect Guru protected
has looked to the shelter of the Eternal. ॥1॥
The one whose protector the Supreme Lord Himself becomes,
ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਪਜੇ; ਮਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
in an instant peace, poise and comfort arise, and the mind is ever at ease. ॥ Rahao
The one the Guru gave the medicine of the Lord's Name,
that Name cut away all their disease.
their whole life was set right. ॥2॥
God has kept God's own age-old nature in mind,
and has not weighed our virtues and faults.
The one in whom the Guru's Word took root,
623: has had all their honour kept by it. ॥3॥
I speak Your praise only as You make me speak.
You are the Master, the treasure of virtues, deep and vast of heart.
Nanak, chant the Name of the Eternal, which always stands by us;
God has kept the honour of God's own servant. ॥4॥6॥56॥
The all-pervading Creator stands by them;
not a hair of their spiritual wealth is harmed.
Whose spiritual bathing the Guru made fruitful,
meditating on the Lord, they destroy their sins. ॥1॥
O saints, the pool of the Lord's servants, the holy company, is beautiful.
ਜੋ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸੋ ਕੁਲੁ ਤਰਾਵੈ; ਉਧਾਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਹੈ ਜੀ ਕਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whoever bathes there is liberated, and carries across the whole family too. ॥1॥ Rahao
The whole world sings their praise,
and they gain the fruits the mind desires.
Having bathed, they come away with their spiritual wealth safe and whole,
Whoever bathes in the saints' pool
They do not die and are not reborn,
who meditate on the Lord's Name. ॥3॥
This wisdom of union with God is understood only by one
on whom the Lord is merciful.
Nanak: whoever stays in God's shelter
has all anxiety and worry erased. ॥4॥7॥57॥
The Supreme Lord has kept faith with the servant to the end;
The Guru, attaching them to God's feet, carries them across;
they keep the Lord's Name cherished in the heart. ॥1॥
God is ever the protector of God's own servant.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ; ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In grace God keeps them as God's own, cherishing them as mother and father do. ॥1॥ Rahao
The fortunate have found the True Guru,
who has wiped out the path to Death.
Their mind is absorbed in loving devotion to the Lord;
those fortunate ones live by chanting the Name. ॥2॥
The servant sings the Lord's life-giving Word,
and bathes in the dust of the holy.
God Himself has given God's own Name;
God the Creator has saved them. ॥3॥
The Lord's vision is the support of their life;
this is their pure and perfect understanding.
servant Nanak seeks Your shelter, O Master. ॥4॥8॥58॥
The one the Perfect Guru attached to God's feet
has found the Lord, the ever-present helper.
Wherever we go, we are at peace,
but it is God who in grace unites us. ॥1॥
Sing the Lord's praises ever with love.
ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੁ; ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You will gain all the fruits the mind desires, and the Lord will be the companion of your soul. ॥1॥ Rahao
The Lord is the support of the breath of life;
I am the dust of the saints' feet.
when in grace they give the gift of the Lord's praise. ॥2॥
The Supreme Lord Himself protects them,
ever a guardian at the side of their soul.
Sing the Lord's praises day and night,
and you will not be cast into birth again. ॥3॥
The one to whom the Creator Himself gives this gift
alone has known the taste of the Lord.
Death's messenger does not come near them;
Nanak, in God's shelter they find peace. ॥4॥9॥59॥
624: The Perfect Guru has made my life fruitful;
Peace and joy have arisen within: this is my bathing.
I am a sacrifice to the Supreme Lord. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਵਲ; ਰਿਦ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Whoever enshrines the Guru's lotus feet in the heart
ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ. ਤਿਲ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ; ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
meets not the slightest obstacle; the Guru sets all their affairs right. ॥1॥ Rahao
Meeting the Guru, one sheds evil-mindedness;
even the fallen all become pure.
Those who bathe in the pool of the Lord's servants
have all the sins they committed washed away. ॥2॥
Sing the praises of the Lord of the universe always;
join the holy company and meditate.
They gain the fruits the mind desires,
who meditate on the Perfect Guru in the heart. ॥3॥
The Lord is great, the Sustainer of the world, the embodiment of bliss;
chanting the Lord of supreme bliss, one gains spiritual life.
When servant Nanak meditated on the Name,
God kept God's age-old loving nature. ॥4॥10॥60॥
ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਛਤ੍ਰ. ਮੇਘ ਘਟਾ ਘਟ; ਦਾਮਨਿ ਚਮਕਿ ਡਰਾਇਓ ॥
Clouds spread like a canopy in all ten directions, and the lightning's flash frightens;
ਸੇਜ ਇਕੇਲੀ. ਨੀਦ ਨਹੁ ਨੈਨਹ; ਪਿਰੁ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਸਿਧਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
her bed is empty, no sleep comes to her eyes, for her husband has gone abroad. ॥1॥
O mother, now not even a message comes from him.
ਏਕ ਕੋਸਰੋ. ਸਿਧਿ ਕਰਤ ਲਾਲੁ; ਤਬ ਚਤੁਰ ਪਾਤਰੋ ਆਇਓ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Once, when my beloved went but a mile away, four letters would come. ॥ Rahao
ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ. ਇਹੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ; ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਇਓ ॥
How could I forget this dear Beloved, Master of all virtues, Giver of every comfort?
ਮੰਦਰਿ ਚਰਿ ਕੈ. ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਉ; ਨੈਨ. ਨੀਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਆਇਓ ॥੨॥
Climbing up the house I watch the road, and my eyes fill with tears. ॥2॥
ਹਉ ਹਉ ਭੀਤਿ ਭਇਓ ਹੈ ਬੀਚੋ; ਸੁਨਤ ਦੇਸਿ ਨਿਕਟਾਇਓ ॥
I hear that He dwells near, in my own heart, but the wall of ego stands between us;
ਭਾਂਭੀਰੀ ਕੇ ਪਾਤ ਪਰਦੋ; ਬਿਨੁ ਪੇਖੇ. ਦੂਰਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
the veil is as thin as a butterfly's wing, yet unseen He seems far away. ॥3॥
ਭਇਓ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਸਗਰੋ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਓ ॥
When the Master of all becomes merciful, all the pain of separation is taken away.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਉਮੈ ਭੀਤਿ, ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਈ; ਤਉ ਦਇਆਰੁ ਬੀਠਲੋ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੪॥
Says Nanak: when the Guru broke down the wall of ego, then she found the merciful Lord within. ॥4॥
All her anxiety is gone, O mother;
the Guru has united her with the One she longed for,
ਸਰਬ ਗੁਨਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਾਇਓ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧੧॥੬੧॥
the Sovereign, the treasure of all virtues. ॥ Second Rahao ॥11॥61॥
ਗਈ ਬਹੋੜੁ. ਬੰਦੀ ਛੋੜੁ; ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਦੁਖਦਾਰੀ ॥
O God, You restore what was lost and free from captivity; You are formless and comfort us in pain.
ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ. ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ; ਲੋਭੀ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ॥
I know no good deeds or dharma; I am greedy and caught in Maya.
ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਭਗਤੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ; ਇਹ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Yet I have come to be called a devotee of the Lord of the universe; so keep Your own honour. ॥1॥
O dear Lord, You are the honour of the dishonoured.
ਨਿਚੀਜਿਆ. ਚੀਜ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ; ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My Lord makes the worthless worthy; I am a sacrifice to Your power. ॥ Rahao
ਜੈਸਾ ਬਾਲਕੁ. ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ; ਲਖ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
As a child, by its nature, commits countless mistakes,
ਕਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਝਿੜਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ; ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਪਿਤਾ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
and the father teaches and scolds in many ways, but then hugs it close again,
ਪਿਛਲੇ ਅਉਗੁਣ. ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਆਗੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
so God forgives past faults and sets one on the right path ahead. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ; ਤਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
The Lord knows every heart and every state; to whom else can we tell our plight?
ਕਹਣੈ ਕਥਨਿ. ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ; ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈਐ ॥
The Lord is not pleased by mere words; the one who pleases the Lord has honour kept.
ਅਵਰ ਓਟ ਮੈ ਸਗਲੀ ਦੇਖੀ; ਇਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਰਹਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
I have seen every other support; I rely on Your support alone. ॥3॥
625: ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ॥
The Master, becoming kind and merciful, Himself hears their prayer,
ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ; ਸਭ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤੀ ॥
unites them with the Perfect True Guru, and every worry of the mind is ended.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੰਤੀ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੬੨॥
Servant Nanak: the one into whose mouth the Guru puts the medicine of the Lord's Name lives in peace. ॥4॥12॥62॥
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦਾ; ਦੁਖ ਕਲੇਸ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
Remembering You, O God, people become joyful, and all pain and trouble flee.
ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਧਿਆਵਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ; ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਂਠੇ ॥੧॥
Singing the praises of their God and meditating, they set all their affairs right. ॥1॥
Your Name gives spiritual life to the world.
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਦੀਓ ਉਪਦੇਸਾ; ਜਪਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whoever the Perfect Guru taught, chanting the Name, has crossed the terrifying world-ocean. ॥ Rahao
ਤੂਹੈ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ. ਸੁਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂਹੈ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
You are Your own counsellor, You hear all, O God; You are the doer of everything.
ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ. ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ; ਕਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਜੰਤੁ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
You Yourself are the giver and Yourself the enjoyer; what can this poor creature do? ॥2॥
ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ; ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Which of Your virtues can I tell? Your worth cannot be described.
ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ; ਅਚਰਜੁ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੩॥
One lives by beholding one's God; wondrous is Your greatness. ॥3॥
ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ. ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ; ਪਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
O God, O Master, showing grace Yourself You grant honour and perfect understanding.
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ; ਬਾਛਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਧੂਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੬੩॥
Nanak is ever a sacrifice, and begs for the dust of the saints' feet. ॥4॥13॥63॥
Whoever bows to the Perfect Guru,
God sets all their affairs right.
The Lord showed grace to them,
and God kept their honour in full. ॥1॥

Perfect is the Guru, flawless the Guru's teaching, who sets us to the work of the Perfect Lord.
ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਾਗਿ. ਤਰਿਓ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ; ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੯੦॥
Nanak: holding to the Guru's feet and chanting the Lord's Name, I am crossing the world-ocean. ॥4॥26॥90॥
ਭਇਓ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ. ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ; ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਥਾਟੀ ॥
The destroyer of the poor's pain has become merciful, and has made every arrangement.
ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਓ. ਜਨੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ; ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਬੇੜੀ ਕਾਟੀ ॥੧॥
In an instant God saved God's servant; the Perfect Guru cut away the shackles. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
O my mind, ever meditate on the Guru and the Lord of the universe.
ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ; ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
All suffering leaves this body, and one gains the fruit the mind desires. ॥ Rahao
ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
The God who created all beings is lofty, unreachable and infinite.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਭਏ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੨੭॥੯੧॥
Nanak: those who meditated on the Name in the holy company were radiant in the Lord's court. ॥2॥27॥91॥
day and night I ever meditate on the One
who gave a hand and protected those
who tasted the supreme essence of the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
